findings.title: Redefining `self.downsize` overwrites the 4-argument overload instead of overloading it
findings.body: Ruby does not support method overloading by arity. Defining `def self.downsize(from, to, dimensions, opts={})` on line 149 immediately overwrites `def self.downsize(from, to, max_width, max_height, opts={})` defined on line 145. Any existing caller passing `(from, to, max_width, max_height)` (or `(from, to, max_width, max_height, opts)`) will either bind `max_height` to `opts` (causing `NoMethodError` when `opts[:allow_animation]` is indexed on an Integer, and passing only `max_width` as the geometry string) or raise `ArgumentError: wrong number of arguments (5 for 3..4)`.

findings.title: `gifsicle --resize-fit` does not accept percentage dimensions like `"80%"`
findings.body: `UploadsController#create_upload` calls `OptimizedImage.downsize(tempfile.path, tempfile.path, "80%", allow_animation: SiteSetting.allow_animated_thumbnails)`. When the uploaded file has a `.gif` extension and `allow_animation` is true, `optimize` dispatches to `downsize_instructions_animated`, which delegates to `resize_instructions_animated` and runs `gifsicle ... --resize-fit 80%`. In gifsicle, `--resize-fit` only accepts `WxH`, `Wx_`, or `_xH` pixel dimensions (percentages require `--scale 0.8`). Gifsicle exits with a non-zero status on `80%`, so animated GIFs larger than `max_image_size_kb` are never downsized across all 5 attempts and fail the upload.

findings.title: Client-side size check ignores `max_attachment_size_kb` and `max_image_size_kb` > 10MB
findings.body: `validateUploadedFile` replaces `Discourse.SiteSettings['max_' + type + '_size_kb']` with a hardcoded `10 * 1024` KB for all upload types. Because the server only downsizes images, non-image attachments between `max_attachment_size_kb` and 10 MB are no longer rejected before upload and will be uploaded in full only to fail on the server; conversely, if a site configures `max_attachment_size_kb` or `max_image_size_kb` above 10 MB, the client now blocks valid uploads.

findings.title: Downsize loop ignores `OptimizedImage.downsize` failure and retries 5 times on unconvertible files
findings.body: `OptimizedImage.downsize` returns `false` when `convert` or `gifsicle` fails (for example on SVG uploads, which `FileHelper.is_image?` treats as images, or corrupt image files). The `while` loop in `create_upload` does not check the return value of `OptimizedImage.downsize` or whether `tempfile.size` actually decreased, so it spawns the external command 5 times in a row with identical inputs before proceeding.
